heading: Employment of additional administrative assistants
lead: The Secretary of the Senate is authorized to employ such administrative assistants as may be necessary in order to carry out the provisions of this Act under the jurisdiction of the Secretary.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: This Act, referred to in text, means act Aug. 2, 1946, ch. 753, 60 Stat. 812, known as the Legislative Reorganization Act of 1946. For complete classification of this Act to the Code, see Tables.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section was formerly classified to section 74b of this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1996—Pub. L. 104–186 substituted “is” for “and the Clerk of the House are” and “the jurisdiction of the Secretary” for “their respective jurisdictions”.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective Aug. 2, 1946, see section 245 of act Aug. 2, 1946, set out as a note under section 4301 of this title.
